why: A Youssef Lazar preprint claims to prove the Littlewood conjecture for a restricted class of badly-approximable pairs (a genuine case of the stated problem), but arXiv shows it originally submitted Feb 2022 with a revision dated Apr 2025; could not tell whether the 2025 revision reflects new post-snapshot mathematical content or just a resubmission of the pre-snapshot result, and it is an unrefereed preprint.
queries: Youssef Lazar Littlewood conjecture restricted class badly approximable 2025

found.title: The Littlewood conjecture for a restricted class of pairs of real numbers
found.note: Preprint (orig. Feb 2022, revised Apr 2025) proving the conjecture for a restricted class of badly approximable pairs; not read, unclear if revision adds new content.

found.title: Counterexamples to the p(t)-adic Littlewood Conjecture Over Small Finite Fields
found.note: Concerns the p(t)-adic variant, not the original real-number Littlewood conjecture; different statement.

found.title: Variants of the Littlewood conjecture ... discrepancy of van der Corput-Kronecker-type sequences
found.note: About variants and discrepancy of related sequences, not the stated conjecture itself.
